exports.name: JsonValue
exports.description: A JSON value that can be stored in a portable Rules configuration or finding.

exports.name: resolveRulesStatus

exports.name: Rule
exports.description: A deterministic, provider-owned policy unit evaluated by the generic engine.

exports.name: RuleCapability
exports.description: A capability that a rule needs from the context supplied by its consumer.

exports.name: RuleDependency
exports.description: One dependency declared by stable rule ID and resolved by the generic evaluator.

exports.name: RuleEvaluationDiagnostic
exports.description: One execution diagnostic that explains why a configured rule could not run.

exports.name: RuleEvaluationInput
exports.description: The immutable input supplied to a rule after the evaluator has resolved its dependencies.

exports.name: RuleEvaluationOutcome
exports.description: One provider result that is independent of evaluation failure and later policy decisions.

exports.name: RuleEvaluationPlan
exports.description: A consumer-neutral projection of selected rule roots and their resolved dependency closure.

exports.name: RuleEvaluationPlanNode
exports.description: One serializable node in the deterministic execution graph for a scoped Rules run.

exports.name: RuleEvaluationResult
exports.description: The deterministic generic result shared by every Rules consumer.

exports.name: RuleFacet
exports.description: A provider-owned, stable facet used to classify rules without prescribing presentation.

exports.name: RuleFinding
exports.description: One serializable, consumer-neutral result produced by a rule.

exports.name: RuleIdentity
exports.description: A stable, versioned identity for one provider-owned policy definition.

exports.name: RuleOptionDiagnostic
exports.description: A validation error returned by a provider for its own serializable options.

exports.name: RuleRegistry
exports.description: A registry that resolves rules without provider discovery or domain-specific branches.

exports.name: RuleResult
exports.description: One serializable evaluation result for a versioned rule at one exact semantic scope.

exports.name: RuleResultDiagnostic
exports.description: A serializable diagnostic emitted by the evaluator while resolving a rule instance.

exports.name: RuleResultStatus
exports.description: The complete deterministic state of one evaluated rule instance.

exports.name: RulesConfig
exports.description: The canonical JSON-only configuration stored in a repository rules.json file.

exports.name: RulesConfigDiagnostic
exports.description: A portable diagnostic emitted while parsing or applying a Rules configuration.

exports.name: RulesConfigReadResult
exports.description: The result of reading a repository rules.json file without hiding parse failures.

exports.name: RulesConfigRule
exports.description: One enabled/disabled rule selection with serializable provider options.

exports.name: RulesConfigValidationOptions
exports.description: Extra facts used to validate configured rule IDs, options, and required capabilities.

exports.name: RulesConfigValidationResult
exports.description: The result of validating a raw JSON configuration against optional provider knowledge.

exports.name: RuleScope
exports.description: The semantic target for a rule execution, independent of host tenancy or storage.

exports.name: RuleSelection
exports.description: Explicit roots selected for a run; dependency closure is evaluator-owned and never provider-owned.

exports.name: RuleSet
exports.description: A named collection of independently supplied rules that can compose with other providers.

exports.name: RuleSeverity
exports.description: The canonical impact levels used by every Rules provider.

exports.name: RuleSourceLocation
exports.description: An optional source location supplied as factual evidence by a provider.

exports.name: RulesStatusDescriptor
exports.description: A stable status summary suitable for consumer-specific presentation.

exports.name: RuleSubject
exports.description: An affected semantic subject reported independently of any presentation consumer.

exports.name: validateRulesConfig
exports.description: Validate canonical rules.json data, optionally against a concrete rule registry.

exports.name: writeRulesConfigAsync
exports.description: Validate and atomically write canonical rules.json configuration through the filesystem adapter.
